title: FreshCache temporal-parameter selection -- protocol
note: This protocol was written after the recorded configuration already existed; it does not record how the recorded configuration was chosen. It fixes the search space, objective, constraints and tie-break below, which were hashed before any held-out number was computed.

identified_parameterisation.statement: The gate admits iff age <= h_fc * k_t with k_t = -ln(1-eps_t)/(m_t*ln2). Decisions depend on (m_t, eps_t) only through k_t, so the multiplier/budget split is not identifiable. Selection is therefore over k_t, reported in the manuscript's (m, eps) coordinates with m held at its recorded value.

search_space.tier_multipliers: held at recorded (1.5, 1.2, 1.0); see identified_parameterisation -- varying them is redundant with varying eps
search_space.half_lives: held at recorded calibrated values; this workstream does not re-fit them

data.leakage_rule: no held-out request is replayed until the configuration is frozen and hashed

constraints: C1: observable content drift must not exceed the recorded configuration's validation drift by more than 0.25 pp (absolute)
C2: L1 hits must not exceed the recorded configuration's validation L1 hits (each L1 hit is an answer served without regeneration, so this caps answer-risk exposure)
C3: observable coverage must be at least 95% of the recorded configuration's validation coverage, so drift is not lowered by measuring less

answer_quality_note: Answer quality (WAI) is NOT part of the selection objective: scoring it per cell would require generation and judging for all 48 cells, which was not run. C2 caps answer-risk exposure by construction instead. WAI is measured only on the frozen configurations at held-out scripts/evaluation time, and is therefore an out-of-sample check, not a selection criterion.
configurations_to_evaluate_on_heldout: EquivalentTTL derived from the calibrated rule
